name: FirstBuild at CoCREATE
summary: A GE Appliances FirstBuild facility in Stamford offering free membership, with metalworking, woodshop and advanced prototyping.

operations.hours_note: Tue & Thu 1pm–7:30pm; Wed & Fri noon–7:30pm; Sat 9am–4:30pm; closed Sun–Mon. Some metal shop tools need certification.

sources.note: Superseded Google Site, recovered 2026-08-28 from its still-live sites.google.com address. Street address, website and descriptive text are transcribed from it verbatim. The logo is the space's own mark, recovered from the same page.
'CT Makerspaces Map' My Map attached to the superseded site. Coordinates are the 'FirstBuild' pin, transcribed from its KML, not geocoded.
GE Appliances announcement of the CoCREATE opening, 12 October 2023 — a combined microfactory, community makerspace and design centre in Stamford.

Own page: 'Whether you are a maker, tinkerer, or just curious, stop in'; FirstBuild hours as recorded in hours_note; tools are reserved online, '(certification may be required)' for some metal shop tools; 47 John Street, Stamford 06902. Open to the public also stated by the CT steward (J.R. Logan), 2026-11-18.
